1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Amarebe.” Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

2.text: Mana, nkiza kuko amazi ageze no ku bugingo bwanjye.

3.text: Ndigise mu byondo birebire,Bidafite aho umuntu yahagarara,Ngeze muri nyina umuvumbi urantembana.

4.text: Kurira kuranduhije umuhogo wanjye urumye,Amaso yanjye yarerutse ngitegereza Imana yanjye.

5.text: Abanyangira ubusa baruta umusatsi wo ku mutwe wanjye ubwinshiAbashaka kundimbura bampora impamvu z'ibinyoma barakomeye,Ni bwo narihishijwe icyo ntanyaze.

6.text: Mana, ni wowe uzi ubupfu bwanjye,Ibyaha byanjye ntubihishwa.

7.text: Mwami, Uwiteka Nyiringabo,Abagutegereza be kumwazwa n'ibyanjye,Mana y'Abisirayeli,Abagushaka be guterwa igisuzuguriro n'ibyanjye.

8.text: Kuko nihanganira ibitutsi bakuntukira,Mu maso hanjye huzuye ipfunwe.

9.text: Mpindutse umushyitsi kuri bene data,N'umunyamahanga kuri bene mama.

10.text: Kuko ishyaka ry'inzu yawe rindya,Ibitutsi by'abagutuka byaguye kuri jye.

11.text: Ubwo nariraga ngahanisha umutima wanjye kwiyiriza ubusa,Byampindukiye ibitutsi.

12.text: Ubwo nambaraga ibigunira,Nabaye iciro ry'imigani kuri bo.

13.text: Abicara mu marembo baramvuga,Ndi indirimbo y'abasinzi.

14.text: Ariko jyeweho ni wowe nsenga Uwiteka,Mana, mu gihe cyo kwemererwamo,Ku bwo kugira neza kwawe kwinshi,Unsubirishe umurava w'agakiza kawe.

15.text: Unsayure mu byondo ne kurigita,Nkire abanyanga nkire n'amazi maremare.

16.text: Umuvumba we kuntembana,Imihengeri he kumira,Rwa rwobo rwe kumbumbiraho umunwa warwo.

17.text: Uwiteka, unsubize kuko imbabazi zawe ari nziza,Unkebuke nk'uko kugira neza kwawe ari kwinshi.

18.text: Kandi jyewe umugaragu wawe ntumpishe mu maso hawe,Kuko mfite umubabaro unsubize vuba.

19.text: Wegere ubugingo bwanjye ubukize,Uncungure ku bw'abanzi banjye.

20.text: Ni wowe uzi uko ntukwa,N'isoni zanjye n'igisuzuguriro cyanjye na byo urabizi,Abanzi banjye bose bari imbere yawe.

21.text: Ibitutsi byamenaguye umutima ndarwaye cyane,Nashatse uwangirira imbabazi ariko ntihaboneka n'umwe,Nashatse abo kumara umubabaro ndababura.

22.text: Kandi bampaye indurwe kuba ibyokurya byanjye,Ngize inyota bampa umushari wa vino.

23.text: Ameza yabo imbere yabo ahinduke ikigoyi,Bakiri mu mahoro ahinduke umutego.

24.text: Amaso yabo ahumwe batareba,Uhindishe umushyitsi ikiyunguyungu cyabo iteka.

25.text: Ubasukeho uburakari bwawe,Umujinya w'inkazi wawe ubagereho.

26.text: Iwabo hasigare ubusa,Kandi ntihakagire uba mu mahema yabo.

27.text: Kuko bagenza uwo wakubise,Kandi bavuga umubabaro w'abo wakomerekeje.

28.text: Rundanya ibyaha ku byaha byabo,Be kwinjira mu byo gukiranuka kwawe.

29.text: Basibanganywe mu gitabo cy'ubugingo,Be kwandikanwa n'abakiranutsi.

30.text: Ariko jyeweho ndi umunyamubabaro ndaribwa,Mana, agakiza kawe kanshyire hejuru.

31.text: Nzashimisha izina ry'Imana indirimbo,Nzayihimbarisha ishimwe ry'ibyo yankoreye.

32.text: Ibyo bizanezeza Uwiteka birushe impfizi,Cyangwa ikimasa gifite amahembe cyatūye inzara.

33.text: Abagwaneza bazabireba bishime,Mwa bashaka Imana mwe,Imitima yanyu isubizwemo ubugingo.

34.text: Kuko Uwiteka yumva abakene,Ntasuzugura abe bari mu nzu y'imbohe.

36.text: Kuko Imana izakiza i Siyoni,Ikubaka imidugudu ya Yuda,Bazayibamo igihugu kibabere gakondo.

37.text: Kandi urubyaro rw'abagaragu bayo ruzakiragwa,Abakunda izina ryayo bazagituramo.
